quote: Eye inter-distances and diameters: AME 0.06, AME-AME 0.02, ALE 0.09, AME-ALE 0.06, PME 0.09, PME-PME 0.06, PLE 0.07, and PME-PLE 0.06.

method: measurement of the preserved female paratype IZCAS-Ar44931 as listed in the Description sentence 'Eye inter-distances and diameters'; the Methods define no eye dimension
conditions: Female of Bifurcia luding sp. nov. Measured specimen: female paratype IZCAS-Ar44931. Type material as printed (pieces joined): 'Holotype ♂ (IZCAS-Ar44930) and paratype 1♀ (IZCAS-Ar44931), Luding County (29°51.60'N, 102°2.83'E, 2936 m elev.), Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan, China, 20/07/2004, Lihong Tu leg.' Preceding sentence in the female description: 'Female (paratype). Total length: 2.53, carapace 0.96 long, 0.84 wide, abdomen 1.66 long, 1.16 wide.'
